items.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Redraw image 1, the Execution card, keeping its EXACT square composition and original abstract subject. Image 2 is DRAWING STYLE reference only, do not copy its character, weapon, costume or pose. Preserve the near-black blue charcoal empty background, a thin red-white vertical slash precisely down the center crossing the full height, and a thin horizontal red-white slash through the exact center spanning the full width. At their crossing preserve the concentrated brilliant white explosive slash-burst, asymmetric long red-white pointed streaks especially extending upper-right and lower-left. Keep the burst near its original size with generous dark negative space around it. Consolidate the many little twigs and star-shaped sparks into a few strong intentional blade-like painted slashes, reduce decorative noise. Rough hand-painted anime color study: large connected opaque color masses, wide directional swipes and blunt dabs, handmade broken edges, selective unfinished brush coverage, hard-edged light and dark grouping, low detail density. White at the impact, concentrated crimson edges, a few muted red dark planes. Quiet matte background. Avoid glossy 3D, soft airbrush glow, all-over texture filters, tiny facet mosaics or dense scratches. No characters, objects, scenery, text, frame, watermark or UI.
